observations: The page number «9» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «2» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L01-L05: the two columns of chapter 7 end with a bracketed passage in the right column only, the left column empty beside it; L01 begins with a paragraph indent. Note 1: O writes the bracketed passage in the margin. From L06 the text is again printed across the full width.

L06-L13: the measure of the degree after the Chaldeans: a mile of 4000 camel's paces, 33 1/3 miles to half a degree on earth, 24000 miles to the whole circle of the earth; checked: 66 2/3 miles to the degree, 100 miles to a degree and a half, 1000 to fifteen degrees, 2000 to a sign of thirty degrees, 24000 to the twelve signs (L12-L13), as the text says. L06: «Caldeos» is letter-spaced.

L17: «duo signa XVII gradus LV dakaicae», the apogee of the sun, 2 signs 17° 55′, that is 77° 55′. The final I of «XVII» is printed with its foot broken. L21-L22: the equation is added to the mean motion when the argument is more than six signs and subtracted when it is less.

N02: the fourth numeral of «XXXlIII» is a lower-case l, narrower than the I's (7 px against 9-10 px) and with a slanting head serif; see the critical note. N04, N05, N08: «M{sub:2}», M with a lowered 2, the second hand of M. N02, N07: the numerals with a bar over them as printed, {ov:IIII}, {ov:II}, {ov:XXIIII}, {ov:XIIII}. N03: «C N», the two sigla with a space between them. N08: «M{sub:2} —», without a point after the siglum.
L09, L22 and N17: the colon and the semicolon stand after the thin space of the edition (14, 8 and 10 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the numeral that C corrects, thirty-four, is set with a lower-case l in the place of the first I, as on p. 2 (N04)
